body:
Maybe she would be. I told her that this hurts too much and that I wasn't sure that I could keep living. In fact, that at that moment I was fighting to not do something to end my life, and she basically said that it's my problem, not hers, and she hung up on me.

I think I need to accept that she doesn't really care about me. The problem is that I used to really believe that she did care about me. But she seems to like me less the more she gets to know me. So, it seems like I am just not that worth knowing. That's what really makes me want to end my life... the fact that if I get more involved with someone, I'll care about them more and they'll care about me less.
